dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 18, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Guardians Blast Tigers, Rays Crush Orioles in Dominant Fashion**

The Cleveland Guardians continued their winning ways, taking down the Detroit Tigers 8-2 behind a strong team effort. José Ramírez led the charge with a 3-hit, 3-RBI performance, including his 8th home run of the season. Meanwhile, in a blowout win, the Tampa Bay Rays pounded the Baltimore Orioles 16-6, with Junior Caminero delivering a 4-RBI performance and Shane McClanahan dominating on the mound.

In other games, the Miami Marlins routed the Atlanta Braves 12-0, with Xavier Edwards and Javier Sanoja combining for 5 home runs. The New York Mets also enjoyed a big win, defeating the Washington Nationals 16-7 behind a 6-K performance from Jake Irvin.
